zen-official.note: Official Zen 1.23.2b DMG (thin LTO and PGO, cross-compiled by Zen's CI), app update disabled by policy

zen-stock.note: Zen 1.23.2b built here without changes, release options without LTO and PGO

firefox.note: Official Firefox 157.0.1 en-US DMG, app update disabled by policy

zen-stock-signed.note: zen-stock signed with the Apple Development identity and Firefox's hardened runtime entitlements (scripts/sign-app); for the DRM check

origin.note: Origin, the build being measured: v3 (cuts, Origin's prefs, Phosphor icons, lazy loading, startup trims, space-switch and split-view drawing fixes), release options without LTO and PGO like zen-stock

none.note: no browser: WindowServer's coalition and the machine with nothing launched, for scale

origin-signed.note: origin signed with the Apple Development identity and Firefox's hardened runtime entitlements (scripts/sign-app); for the DRM check

origin-v2.note: Origin's second build: adds Phosphor icons, lazy loading, startup trims, the idle trim (off) and Origin's DMG art

origin-v3.note: Origin's third build: v2 plus the space-switch and split-view drawing fixes

origin-release.note: the pre-release build: v3 plus the review fixes, signed with the Apple Development identity (scripts/sign-app)

origin-release-2.note: pre-release 2: the release build with thin LTO and PGO, signed with the Apple Development identity

origin-release-3.note: pre-release 3: debloat pass 2 (Motion, blurs and dormant patches cut, spec prefs, hot paths, memory trim) with thin LTO and PGO, signed with the Apple Development identity

origin-release-4.note: pre-release 4: pre-release 3 with the UI's animations 2.5 times as fast (front-end rebuild on the same LTO and PGO binaries)

origin-5.note: test build for pre-release 5: pre-release 4 plus fix A, fix B and the idle tile buffers, each off by pref; thin LTO and PGO, signed

origin-release-5.note: pre-release 5: idle tile buffers and a surface pool of 4, loops at their own pace, the theme picker built on first open; fixes A and B in the build but off; thin LTO and PGO, signed

origin-release-6.note: pre-release 6: the updater on, with Origin's MAR keys and the GitHub Pages feed; fixes A and B removed; thin LTO and PGO, signed

origin-6-old.note: the build just before pre-release 6 (build 20261014003115), kept to test that it updates itself to pre-release 6

origin-7.note: test build for pre-release 7: pre-release 6 plus the fake wallpaper blur (zen.widget.macos.window-fake-blur, off by default in this build); thin LTO and PGO, signed

origin-release-7.note: pre-release 7: the fake wallpaper blur on, updates only to later builds; thin LTO and PGO, signed
